errors.evidence: This sentence describes the range of the Y-axis but is incorrectly placed within the description of the X-axis, making it seem as though it describes the X-axis.

errors.text_span: Линията започва при стойност от -0,5% в 2012 г.
errors.evidence: The line starts at approximately 3.2% in 2012, not -0.5%. The value in 2015 is close to -0.5%.

errors.text_span: достига максимума си при стойност от 3,5% през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The maximum value in 2017 is visibly higher than 3.5%, at approximately 3.7%.
The value in 2019 is approximately 2.2%, not 2.5%. The value in 2018 is 2.5%.
The description omits the minimum point of the graph, a key feature which occurs in 2015 at a value of approximately -0.7%.

errors.text_span: показана през сив цвят с плътна линия
errors.evidence: The phrasing is awkward and unnatural in Bulgarian. More standard phrasing would be 'показана в сив цвят' (shown in gray color) or simply 'сива плътна линия' (gray solid line).
